title: Smoked Fish Stew
description: A hearty Portuguese-inspired stew featuring smoked fish and a hint of zesty flavor.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onions and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for an additional minute.
Add the smoked sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, stew broth, smoked fish, diced potatoes, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
